question: If p : q : r = 8 : 5 : 12 and r : s = 36 : 18, then what is the value of p : q : r : s?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the common term r in both ratios.

Ratio 1: p : q : r = 8 : 5 : 12

Ratio 2: r : s = 36 : 18

Equate r by multiplying Ratio 1 by 3 (since 12 × 3 = 36).

Combined Ratio = (8 × 3) : (5 × 3) : (12 × 3) : 18 = 24 : 15 : 36 : 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 24:15:36:18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

p : q : r = 8 : 5 : 12

r : s = 36 : 18

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c3e50669f2ccb9c98140c0b0901e80e53e0cd4ad1fa6f98cf90c318bb68b21c.png] 

To join the ratios, the value of the common variable (r) must be the same in both sets.

⇒ In first ratio, r = 12

⇒ In second ratio, r = 36

⇒ L.C.M. of 12 and 36 = 36

⇒ Multiply the first ratio by (36 ÷ 12) = 3

⇒ p : q : r = (8 × 3) : (5 × 3) : (12 × 3) = 24 : 15 : 36

⇒ Now, r : s = 36 : 18

⇒ Combining both: p : q : r : s = 24 : 15 : 36 : 18

**∴ The correct answer is 24:15:36:18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of two ratios a : b and c : d is calculated as (a × c) : (b × d).

Inverse Ratio

The inverse ratio of a : b is 1/a : 1/b, which simplifies to b : a.

Proportion Rule

If four quantities a, b, c, d are in proportion (a : b = c : d), then the product of extremes equals the product of means: a × d = b × c.
